arrays.description: a sequence of arrays to stack; each must have the same shape. If a single array is given it will be treated equivalently to `arrays = unstack(arrays)`, but the implementation will avoid explicit unstacking.
constraints: arrays must have the same shape.

axis.description: specify the axis along which to stack.

out.description: unused by JAX dtype: optional dtype of the resulting array. If not specified, the dtype will be determined via type promotion rules described in :ref:`type-promotion`.
